newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes unchanged vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes unchanged vs dollar.

text.p: Continuing tight bank liquidity helped the Bangladesh taka recover early losses to close flat at 43.7450/7550 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday, dealers said.
"Heavy investments in treasury bills in recent weeks have severely tightened the liquidity. The call market has become volatile. Dollar demand lowered as a result," said one dealer.
Call money was traded at between 13 and 18 percent against the previous 9.0-13 percent. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
